address: The Corn Exchange, Conduit Street, Lichfield,WS13 6JU
bio: Housed within the historic Corn Exchange building, McKenzie's is a warm and friendly restaurant, located only moments from Lichfield city centre.  McKenzie's Restaurant serves a delicious Afternoon Tea in impressive surroundings, and possess beautiful high ceilings, and striking wooden features.  Please note that Afternoon Tea is served on the first floor which is only accessible via stairs.
